summary: Profiles Internet mail for voice messaging, so that different voice mail systems can exchange messages using ordinary email. This second version of the Voice Profile for Internet Mail replaces RFC 1911. It is a proposed standard that was replaced by RFC 3801.

eli5.summary: Voice mail boxes from different companies could not normally swap messages. This lets them send voice recordings to each other as if they were email attachments.

questions: how can voice mail be sent over email
